findings.claim: The install table in README §4 has no row for Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot, Kiro, or ZCode, even though README §3 (line 30) lists all 10 agents as in v2.0 scope.
findings.evidence: README.md:47-54 install table rows: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini/Qwen (combined), Pi, OpenCode 2 — 6 of 10 agents. grep for 'Kiro', 'ZCode', 'Copilot', 'VS Code' in README.md finds zero hits on lines 47-54 or anywhere else with an install command. TECH-SPEC.md also has no install command for these 4 agents (only one unrelated 'Copilot' hit, about skill loaders, TECH-SPEC.md:212).
findings.fix: Add install-table rows for Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot, Kiro and ZCode (each agent's own install mechanism: marketplace, extension command, or git checkout) before README is used as the install guide. Flag as [O] if the install command for any of these 4 is still unverified live.

findings.claim: §2 Principles says 'No CLI, no skills, no extra commands, no npm' as a flat [D] decision, but §9 names a `/ctx-doctor` and `/ctx-upgrade` skill pair (via ADR-0010) that the install/upgrade guide depends on.
findings.evidence: README.md:21 'no skills' vs ADR-0010 title 'ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade stay, rebuilt for v2' and its line 'The /ctx-upgrade skill then runs ctx_doctor'. Not the same contradiction as review item #1 (7 vs 9 tools) — this one is about skills, not tool count.
findings.fix: Narrow README §2's 'no skills' line to 'no feature skills beyond doctor/upgrade', or state plainly which skills v2 ships, so a reader of the outline does not conclude doctor/upgrade skills were cut.

covered: docs/v2 top-level files and adr/ list
